---
title: "Slaapscore vs Hartslag — Analyse"
author: "Robin Offringa"


## 1. Libraries laden

```{r libraries}
library(ggplot2)
```

---

## 2. Data inladen

```{r data-laden}
sleep_data     <- read.csv("/Users/robinoffringa/Desktop/De-Wetenschappelijke-Cyclus/Takeout/Fitbit/Sleep Score/sleep_score.csv")
heartrate_data <- read.csv("/Users/robinoffringa/Desktop/De-Wetenschappelijke-Cyclus/Takeout/Fitbit/average_heart_rate_excluding_sleep.csv")
```

---

## 3. Data voorbereiden & samenvoegen

```{r data-prep}
# Datumkolommen omzetten
sleep_data$date     <- as.Date(sleep_data$timestamp)
heartrate_data$date <- as.Date(heartrate_data$date)

# Merge op datum
data <- merge(
  sleep_data[, c("date", "overall_score", "resting_heart_rate")],
  heartrate_data[, c("date", "average_heart_rate")],
  by = "date"
)

# Verwijder rijen met ontbrekende waarden
data <- data[complete.cases(data), ]

cat("Data punten: n =", nrow(data), "\n")
```

---

## 4. Beschrijvende statistieken

```{r statistieken}
cat("Slaapscore       — Mean:", round(mean(data$overall_score), 2),
    ", SD:", round(sd(data$overall_score), 2), "\n")

cat("Hartslag overdag — Mean:", round(mean(data$average_heart_rate), 2),
    ", SD:", round(sd(data$average_heart_rate), 2), "\n")
```

---

## 5. Analyse A — Slaapscore vs Hartslag Overdag

### Correlatie

```{r correlatie-hartslag}
corr <- cor.test(data$overall_score, data$average_heart_rate, alternative = "less")
cat("r =", round(corr$estimate, 3), "\n")
cat("p =", round(corr$p.value, 3), "\n")
```

### Plot

```{r plot-hartslag, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
ggplot(data, aes(x = average_heart_rate, y = overall_score)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Slaapscore vs Hartslag Overdag",
    x     = "Gemiddelde Hartslag (bpm)",
    y     = "Slaapscore"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

## 6. Analyse B — Slaapscore vs Rusthartslag

### Correlatie

```{r correlatie-rusthartslag}
corr2 <- cor.test(data$overall_score, data$resting_heart_rate, alternative = "less")
cat("r =", round(corr2$estimate, 3), "\n")
cat("p =", round(corr2$p.value, 3), "\n")
```

### Plot

```{r plot-rusthartslag, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
ggplot(data, aes(x = resting_heart_rate, y = overall_score)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Slaapscore vs Rusthartslag",
    x     = "Rusthartslag (bpm)",
    y     = "Slaapscore"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
